climate.public_context: India opposed a separate Council climate-security track and defended the inclusive UNFCCC process. The United Kingdom supported a Council role in addressing security risks from climate change.
options: Voluntary Glasgow follow-up through the UNFCCC
A new standing Council climate-security reporting track
Country-requested risk briefings tied to existing Council mandates

sanctions.public_context: India emphasized diversion safeguards, proactive monitoring and robust reporting. Brazil backed predictable humanitarian delivery while recognizing security concerns.
options: Prompt aid with targeted checks and exceptional escalation
Prompt aid with proactive monitoring and standardized diversion reports

women_peace_security.public_context: After adoption of resolution 2467, both delegations welcomed adoption while deploring missing health-care language. France addressed access to abortion for involuntary pregnancies. The United Kingdom highlighted civil society and justice.
options: Independent survivor care with confidential referrals
Survivor care with resourced civil-society consultation
A judicial referral scheme without dedicated health services
Resourced survivor care and independent civil-society and justice tracks
